HOW IT WORKS

How it works, privacy and data limits.

How the Airport Ready Guide, travel tools and flight information are meant to be used.

▣Your preparation in four stepsGet your guide, review, prepare, travel ready.

0. Flight Monitor: enter an access code on the Flight Monitor page to unlock it. 1. Get your guide: use the free digital sample or request a printed copy. 2. Review your checklist. 3. Prepare documents, luggage, schedule and transportation. 4. Review before departure and follow official airport and airline instructions.

✈Flight information limitationsInformational use only.

The Skyvector monitor aggregates public aircraft observations, airport reference records and modelled weather where providers permit access. It is not a certified flight-tracking service and must not be used for navigation, dispatch, air-traffic control or safety-critical decisions. Provider coverage, browser access, latency and terms can change.

◇PrivacyNothing is sent to a server.

This site has no accounts, orders or payments. Once you enter a valid access code, your browser remembers that the Flight Monitor is unlocked. Never enter passport numbers or payment-card details.

THE BRAND BEHIND THE PROJECT

GateReady PH brand & business documents.

These project worksheets record the brand direction and an early business-pitch concept. Downloadable public copies have the student name and class section removed.

01 / BRAND IDENTITY

Pack smart. Travel ready.

The brand worksheet describes GateReady PH as a practical, affordable, reliable, friendly and organized travel-preparation brand. Its logo concept uses a luggage tag, dotted route and check mark, with navy and sky blue as the core colors.

Download brand identity worksheet ↓
02 / BUSINESS PITCH

Who the project is designed to help

The pitch planner identifies Filipino students, young adults, families and first-time flyers as its intended audience. It describes an early Travel Mini Kit concept for organizing basic travel items and reminders.

Download business pitch planner ↓

The pitch planner describes an earlier Travel Mini Kit concept; the current offering is the Airport Ready Guide and free tools on this site.

FAQ

What is the Airport Ready Guide?

A practical booklet of airport preparation reminders, transportation planning checklists and travel essentials.

Is it available digitally?

Yes. The free digital sample is on this page; use Print sample to save it as a PDF.

Does GateLink provide transportation?

No. It provides preparation materials only and does not operate transportation services.

How much does the printed guide cost?

The proposed starting price is ₱49 per copy, subject to final pricing and availability. Requests are confirmed manually; no payment is taken on this site.

Privacy Notice

This website has no accounts, sign-in, orders or payments, and the access code you type is checked inside your browser.

The only thing remembered is that the Flight Monitor was unlocked, stored in your own browser (local storage). Clear your browser data for this site to remove it.

The Flight Monitor loads public aviation data from third-party providers, which may receive your IP address as part of normal web requests. Their own terms apply.

Please do not enter passport numbers, payment-card details or passwords anywhere on this site.
